text: Aqara FP2 mmWave sensors replaced the old PIR motion sensors in the living room because the FP2's zone targeting actually keeps the lights on while reading still on the couch.
Nix-built container images replaced the Dockerfile stack for the research toolbox; the closure graph gave byte-identical reproducibility across machines.
The miscarriage on 2025-07-03 at 11 weeks reshaped how I see the next pregnancy attempt; no scan photos on the fridge this time, no telling people before 16 weeks.
Neo4j Bloom was rolled out to the analysts for exploratory graph views; the no-Cypher search bar replaced their ad-hoc Gephi exports.
The Sansaire Delta replaced the Polyscience CREATIVE on the deep-bath sous-vide setup because Sansaire's app actually exposes a Webhook trigger when the bath crosses 60C for the chicken thigh batch.
Chose the Saturday slot over the Sunday slot at the community garden; the Saturday group does the hard dig-over and the Sunday group just does watering.
Cloudflare R2 kept the large asset blobs outside D1; egress-free reads cut the monthly bandwidth bill by two thirds versus S3.
Btrfs subvolumes replaced separate ext4 partitions on the dev workstations; copy-on-write snapshots let CI rollback an apt-get gone wrong in seconds.

The Petlibro Polar ice-cooled feeder replaced the regular Petlibro Granary for the raw-food diet because the thermal fail-safe cuts the thaw timer if the basement freezer compressor trips on the Sense energy monitor.
The Astro 5.2 rebuild replaced the Gatsby 4 personal site on 2026-03-14 after the Gatsby build times on Netlify crept past seven minutes and MDX hot-reload broke under Node 20.
Planner hints stayed off by default; pg_hint_plan was approved only for documented escape-hatch cases where the cost model misbehaved on extreme skew.
Airbyte replaced Fivetran on the low-priority ad-platform sources; self-hosted OSS saved 18k per year once volume crossed the tier cliff.
Replaced the Withings Body Scan with a Renpho Elis 2 because the Withings Health Mate stopped exporting raw bioimpedance to Apple Health after the 2026-01 firmware rollout.
Flux Helm controller replaced the legacy Tiller install on the lab cluster; the server-side render killed the cluster-admin service account that used to sit idle.
MobX observables still drive the legacy reporting module; we froze the migration because the decorator syntax reads cleanly and the team ships faster than a rewrite would.
Swift concurrency actors moved mutable dashboard state off of ad-hoc locks; race reports in production dropped to zero.

Pawlicy Advisor's comparison table steered the Pepper insurance pick toward Lemonade Pet on 2026-03-14 because the hereditary-coverage filter caught the IVDD rider that Trupanion's plan silently excluded.
Miller-Rabin primality testing trades determinism for speed by accepting a bounded Monte Carlo error.
City Council member Okonkwo's office swapped the Google Forms intake for Tally after an open-records request revealed Google's form-response metadata had leaked constituent IP ranges.
Avro's logical types carried decimal, timestamp-millis, and UUID across the warehouse; ad-hoc string encodings were banned from new schemas.
Apache Ignite was evaluated against Hazelcast for the compute-grid plus cache split; Ignite's SQL surface was richer but the Hazelcast operational story matched the team's runbooks.
Dropped Reselect for a native structuralSharing output in RTK Query 2; one less dependency and the cached result equality was already good enough for the table view.
Replaced try/except Exception around startup with a typed StartupError; the supervisor distinguishes recoverable config faults from fatal binary mismatches and acts differently.

The Four Principles framework replaces earlier casuistic bioethics by providing, across modern bioethics, a shared mid-level vocabulary that clinicians of differing ethical traditions can deliberate with.
Linkerd multicluster mirror service replaced a homegrown DNS-stub bridge; service discovery across the two regions stopped drifting after the swap.
DataHub took over from Marquez as the cross-team catalogue; column-level lineage plus ownership stubs stopped the shadow spreadsheets.
Higher-kinded shape via fp-ts's HKT trick let the repository combinator stay polymorphic across Task and Either; the team accepted the encoding overhead for the reuse.
OTLP metrics over the OpenTelemetry Collector replaced direct StatsD shipping on the mobile backend; native histograms made p99 bucket error disappear.
Switched the morning prayer rhythm from the breviary's Lauds at 07:00 to a shorter lectio divina with the ESV at 06:30; easier to actually hold.
Switched from Shell V-Power to supermarket 95 RON on the Outback in 2025-10 after six months of A-B logging; no measurable mpg or smoothness difference.
Picked Temporal for the new billing retry engine; deterministic replay simplified the retry story.
Pulumi ESC replaced a vaulted dotenv loader on the Go services; the stack config encrypted per environment and resolved at pulumi up time.
The Book of Common Prayer offices app Daily Prayer replaced the paper breviary on commute days; same 1979 rite, lighter bag, cellular dark-mode at dusk.
Web worker pool in the document editor sizes itself to navigator.hardwareConcurrency minus one; leaving a core for the main thread kept input latency under a single frame budget.
RTK Query replaced a bespoke fetch-plus-thunk layer in the billing module; caching, invalidation tags, and polling now come from the toolkit instead of hand-rolled reducers.
Redis maxmemory-policy was set to allkeys-lfu on the recommendation cache; volatile-lru had been evicting unscored keys before the rarely-touched but expensive ones.
The birthday marathon goal moved to 2026-09-12 after the Whoop recovery scores suggested an earlier race was too soon.
Grafana Pyroscope replaced our homegrown pprof scrape loop; differential flame graphs over deploys now take one click.
Switched the spatial smoothing prior from Gaussian to Matern; the latter handled local roughness better.
Cancelled the Zwift subscription and rebuilt the pain cave with a dumb trainer and open-window cycling videos.
The Lisbon flat rental for the autumn trip costs a third of Barcelona's; booking it tomorrow.
Klarna replaced Affirm for the 2026-02-14 Sonos Era 300 split because the 4-payment interest-free plan cleared faster than Affirm's soft-credit-pull step.
Bandcamp replaced iTunes Store purchases on 2026-01-30 for indie releases because Bandcamp Friday waives the platform cut and the 24-bit WAV download lands straight on the NAS.
SilverCloud's CBT module replaced the weekly in-person therapy for aunt Lila's post-widowhood depression screening because the Kaiser referral finally covered the digital program on 2026-03-04.
Retry policies at the workflow level in Temporal centralized backoff with maximum_attempts and initial_interval; per-activity ad-hoc retries went away from the worker code.
Switched the parakeet seed mix from Trill to Versele-Laga Prestige on 2026-03-01; Trill had too much sunflower and Pip's keel was getting padded.
Datadog carried the application monitoring; Honeycomb was adopted alongside for deep trace analytics the Datadog UI flattens.
Gradle version catalogs in libs.versions.toml replaced a tangle of ext properties; a single TOML file now owns every library coordinate across the multi-project build.
Workerd local dev replaced miniflare on the Workers project; parity with the production runtime caught a subtle fetch cache bug.
Replaced runtypes with Zod on the legacy gateway; matching errors and inferred TS types in one place beat the dual-source we had before.
Jitsi Videobridge was retired from the classroom product; LiveKit's simulcast and dynacast covered the low-bandwidth student path better.
Cloudflare Queues carried the webhook retries out of the Worker; the 15-second CPU wall was not enough for the backoff windows.
Hauled the Boss RC-600 out of storage because its MIDI footswitch bank lets me loop the acoustic with Clara over Zoom without a laptop.
zoxide replaced the z script on everyone's dotfiles; the Rust rewrite respects XDG dirs and jumps by frecency without the bash hooks overhead.
The Anbernic RG556 stayed in the drawer once the Steam Deck OLED took over because EmuDeck on the Deck actually saves cloud progress through Syncthing back to the NAS.

PriceBlink's browser-bar comparison replaced a tab-shuffle routine for the Sony WH-1000XM6 hunt on 2026-02-17 because the popup surfaces B&H and Crutchfield prices without leaving the Best Buy listing.
Cohere Rerank replaced an in-house cross-encoder for the long-tail queries; nDCG@10 climbed 3 points and the team avoided the GPU serving overhead.
Swapped MyTherapy for Medisafe on mom's iPhone because the Medisafe Medfriend feature lets my sister Priya get a push alert when the 8pm warfarin dose gets missed.
Opus at 32 kbps handled the voice channel; switching from G.711 saved roughly 60 percent of the RTP bandwidth per participant.
Strava segment chasing on the gravel loop now pulls Wahoo Elemnt Roam GPX files instead of the old Garmin Edge 530.
Barnes Wallis's geodetic airframe design, first used on the Vickers Wellington bomber from 1936, improved damage tolerance compared to earlier monocoque structures.
Cargo.lock is now committed for the CLI crates too; we used to skip it for libraries, but reproducible builds for the shipped binaries outweighed the purism.
Lent 2026 fast this year is alcohol and weekday social media; keeping the Ash Wednesday ashes mark until it rubs off naturally, not washed.
Kagi replaced Google as the default search everywhere because the ad-free results match the home screen-time ethos.
The Crouton iOS recipe library replaced Mela on the bedside iPad because Crouton's Shortcuts integration lets Siri start the bread autolyse timer without unlocking the screen.
BiomeJS is now the formatter plus linter for new TypeScript repos; the oxc stack still felt too unfinished for day jobs.
Replaced the Ray-Ban Wayfarers with Persol 714 foldables on 2026-04-08; the Persol fold flat into the jacket inside pocket and survive a beach week without a hard case.
The contractor selection for the extension went to Bevan Builds over Rockhill; Bevan had three finished jobs within five miles to visit.
Zephyr RTOS device tree overlays carried the custom board pinmux; vendor HAL edits were removed from the firmware tree entirely.
Envoy replaced nginx as the L7 proxy in front of the checkout cluster; xDS dynamic config let the routes update without a reload SIGHUP.
Infuse on the Apple TV 4K replaced the stock tvOS Jellyfin client because the Dolby Vision passthrough finally pipes through Infuse without the washed-out color the Jellyfin client was producing.
Presto got frozen after Trino's governance split; new connectors target Trino and the legacy Presto cluster is read-only until sunset.
Moved my Anki reviews from desktop to mobile on the commute after 2026-01-08; daily reviews went from sporadic to a 91-day unbroken streak.
Swapped PictureThis for PlantNet on the Pixel 9 because PlantNet's citizen-science reference set actually nailed the Quercus ilex cork oak sapling that PictureThis kept calling a holm maple.
ComfyUI replaced Automatic1111 for the album-cover concepting workflow because the node graph keeps the LoRA stack reproducible across the 2026-03-12 cover and the lyric-video stills.
GraphSON replaced a homegrown binary dump on the TinkerPop import pipeline; version 3 JSON typing carried the date and UUID fidelity across engines.
Apache Camel routes orchestrated the cross-broker integration between RabbitMQ and Kafka; the EIP DSL replaced a tangle of small Spring Boot bridges.
Effect-TS landed on the new orchestration module; the Effect<R, E, A> type makes dependencies, errors, and success values all visible in the function signature.
Karpenter replaced the Cluster Autoscaler on the spot fleet; node launches dropped from two minutes to under thirty seconds.
The Advanced Tables plugin rescued the reading-log markdown table after 2026-03-03 because hand-editing 300-row pipe tables in plain vim was eating 40 minutes a week.
Beancount replaced the old Google Sheets ledger on 2026-01-30 because the double-entry constraint caught a two-year-old typo in the 401k cost basis that the spreadsheet never flagged.
Wise's borderless multi-currency account replaced the Charles Schwab checking for foreign ATM withdrawals on 2026-03-01 because the real-time mid-market FX beat the Schwab end-of-day Visa rate.
Wrote a small codemod with jscodeshift to move from React.FC to explicit prop types everywhere.
Renovate config pins group rules and schedule windows per repo; Dependabot could not express weekday-only updates.
Signed up for salsa classes at Bar Salsa Temple to replace the weekly pub quiz slot; two more hips, fewer pints.
mill replaced sbt for the new Scala services; sbt's incremental compiler quirks on cold clones of the CI shards made mill's straight-line task graph the easier sell.
Pinecone was rejected for the on-prem deployment; the managed-only model did not fit the air-gapped customer's compliance requirement.
DxO PhotoLab 8's DeepPRIME XD noise reduction improves on Lightroom's AI Denoise for the Nikon Z8 ISO 12800 concert files because DxO recovers the cymbal shimmer without smearing the hi-hat stand.
Jetpack Compose replaced every XML layout in the onboarding flow; the ViewBinding scaffolding went away and the designer handoff now goes through Compose previews.
Template engine picked Jinja2 with autoescape=True globally; a historical report template that needed raw HTML uses a reviewed |safe filter with a lint-allowed marker.
Moved the localisation pipeline from Crowdin to Weblate; self-hosting gave us translation-memory ownership and stopped the per-string pricing surprise.
smallstep replaced HashiCorp Boundary for operator access; the ACME-style enrolment flow clicked with the existing TLS story.
ICE candidate gathering was capped at 3 seconds on mobile; waiting longer burned the battery without improving the connect ratio in production data.
The Steam Deck library finally stabilised once Proton-GE replaced the default Proton build for the weekend Yakuza runs.
Etrade's Power E*TRADE platform replaced the Robinhood options workflow on 2026-01-18 because the P/L chart with the greeks overlay saved two hours of manual sheet building every expiry Friday.
Randomized TTL jitter of plus-or-minus 10 percent on Memcached broke the synchronized expiry storm on the product catalog cache; without jitter, ten thousand keys expired in the same second.
The Freedom Mac block on 2026-03-22 replaced the manual /etc/hosts redirects I was maintaining; same blocklist, auto-sync across phone and laptop.
Universal compaction on the session store kept SST file count low during bursts; space amplification was the acceptable trade against stall risk.
The woodworking shop notebook moved from index cards to Notion after the router table plans kept disappearing.
The Ratgdo board replaced the original Chamberlain logic on the garage door because Ratgdo speaks ESPHome natively, exposes the obstruction sensor, and avoids the MyQ subscription entirely.
